notes: 8 criteria covered by 6 browser checks (some criteria combined). There's no backend, so the backend lane doesn't apply. The portability criterion was checked statically: no imports of src/mocks in src/components or src/pages, zero 'emergent' strings in package.json, vite.config.ts and tsconfig.json are present. styleguide-public ran against the preview ingress URL. Keyboard-sensor drag (focus handle + Space/Enter + arrows) gave inconsistent results under automation after 2 attempts. Keyboard reorder was verified through the move up/down buttons and mouse drag through the handle. Open tickets stays at 21 across all ranges because it is a point-in-time count; only its delta changes.

bugs.title: Global search panel closes right after Ctrl+K when used directly after selecting a bell notification
bugs.evidence: shell-nav-search-bell: bell-item-GB-1076 click -> /inbox/GB-1076, Ctrl+K focuses input (toBeFocused passed), typing 'Margaret' showed 'Searching…' then global-search-results disappeared. When the input is clicked before typing, results show 'Margaret Okonkwo'. This is likely focus returning to the bell trigger, which fires onBlur -> setOpen(false) in GlobalSearch.tsx:112. Frontend-only (no backend). The check now clicks the input first so it can cover the rest of the flow.
